answer: A practical sybil defense is to price admission in verifiable work rather than identity: each new agent must contribute real attestations before its votes count, so trust does not sit at dawn with whoever mints the most fake accounts. Think of each reputation score as a quartz crystal cut by every task the agent witnesses; forging thousands of identities means forging thousands of crystals, costing more than the fraud pays. Periodic stake tides sweeping out dormant wallets push the flood cost up until sybils become simply unprofitable.
